title: 第4章 好东西真多
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 六十年代的京城，城隍庙早已不复往日香火鼎盛。朱漆剥落，梁柱倾颓，唯有那对石狮子还倔强地守在门口，一只没了半只耳朵，另一只裂了嘴角，像是在苦笑这世道变迁。夜幕四合，辰楠悄步踏进庙院。月光如水银泻地，将荒草染成银白。他深吸一口气，空气中带着煤烟和尘土的味儿。还不等辰楠到地方，就听到里面有声音传出来，声音的主人正是——柳如意和常伟。“你们果然在这里。”辰楠喃喃自语，脑海中浮现出白天掉进水的情形。若非他恰好穿越而来，等浮起来的就是一具尸体。庙堂内蛛网密布，神像蒙尘。辰楠绕过正殿，直奔后厢房。那里有一处隐蔽的地下密室入口，是三人前几日偶然发现的。当时他们还信誓旦旦要共同守护这个秘密，如今想来，不过是那二人稳住原主的伎俩。辰楠藏身于一座残破的屏风后，屏住呼吸。不多时，脚步声由远及近。“伟哥你快点，我怕有人看见。”柳如意的声音，娇柔中带着急切。常伟提着煤油灯走在前面，“放心，这破地方晚上鬼都不来。再说，辰楠那小子已经喂鱼了，没人知道咱们的秘密。”辰楠在暗处冷笑，好一对狗男女，原主是死了，可是他也活了。柳如意穿着碎花小褂，两条麻花辫垂在肩头，月光下显得格外清纯。常伟并没有辰楠高大英挺，可他爸是个领导，样貌虽然一般，可是家世好，因此是不少姑娘的梦中情人。“今晚再搬两箱就好，多了怕引人注意。”常伟说着，挪开墙角的一块活砖，露出向下延伸的阶梯。柳如意点头，“都听你的，只是...总觉得心里不踏实，辰楠刚没，我们就...”“别提那晦气鬼！”常伟打断她，“他自已不小心落水，关我们什么事？再说，少一个人分，不好吗？”常伟说这话时有些心虚，辰楠掉河里是因为他推了一把，而且他还见死不救，否则辰楠也不会死。现在他都还不知道辰楠不仅没死，还在暗中注视着他的一举一动。二人相继走下密室，声音渐远。辰楠从屏风后走出来，他轻手轻脚走到入口处，侧耳倾听。底下传来搬动重物的声音，还有柳如意的喘息：“这大黄鱼真沉啊...”一箱他们也搬不动，只能分批把大黄鱼用挎包装好带出去。“沉才好呢，以前这一根大黄鱼就够普通人家吃半年。”“可惜，如今粮食紧缺，一根大黄鱼换不了多少粮食。”常伟拿起一根大黄鱼一脸惋惜，“等这里的东西全都搬走，咱们也可以安心了。”“这大黄鱼也没有市价，但肯定值不少钱，我们可以拿去黑市换粮食。”柳如意看着大黄鱼双目冒光，现如今金子管控极其严格，私人即便有金子也要藏起来不给人发现。一旦被人发现，那很有可能会被人胡乱扣帽子。会被视为“资本主义的尾巴”或“旧社会的毒瘤”。去黑市换取粮食的风险也很大，被抓到就是投机倒把，不仅害了自已也害了家人。辰楠眯起眼睛，难怪原主记忆中最后几日总是被指使去望风。好一招调虎离山，只能说原主是个舔狗，是个恋爱脑。待二人脚步声远去，辰楠迅速钻入密室。煤油灯还留在那里，昏黄的光线下，二十多个木箱整齐排列。辰楠打开最近的一个，金光灿灿的大黄鱼整齐码放，晃得人眼花。另一个箱子里是卷轴字画，看那装裱精致，绝非寻常之物。“啧啧啧，都是好东西啊！”“柳如意你给原主洗脑很成功。”辰楠搞不懂为何那么大一笔财富，原主会毫不犹豫就让柳如意来支配。只能说这是舔狗属性败给了天命之女了吧。这笔财富在六十年代，足以让无数人疯狂。辰楠在密室里逛了一圈，把所有箱子都检查了一遍。发现密室里的大部分都是古董字画，有三箱大黄鱼，三箱小黄鱼。一箱大黄鱼的重量估计有六十斤，一箱小黄鱼的重量也有三十斤的样子，六箱金子不管在哪里绝对都是一大笔巨额财富。不过更值钱的是那些古董字画，那些才是国宝般的存在。在60年代这种特殊时期，持有金子这种东西一旦被发现，会带来巨大的麻烦，人们对此讳莫如深。辰楠虽然现在也缺钱，但也不敢拿大黄鱼去银行换钱，这可是会被工作人员严格盘问的。询问来源、需要证明、登记记录、政治风险，都是存在的。交代不出黄金的来由就会陷入巨大的麻烦中。交代出黄金的来由也会陷入两难的境地，得不偿失。认为是资本主义的尾巴，有金子的人，不是地主就是资本家出身。搞不好全家送去农场改造都极有可能。而且这个时候的黄金没有市价，因为60年代的黄金很少流通。硬要说一个价格，那就是银行给出的官方价格，三块多钱一克，急用钱的时候倒是可以去黑市兑换。（大黄鱼十两，小黄鱼一两）不过，如今粮食紧缺，一根大黄鱼也换不到多少粮食，可见粮食的重要性。装大黄鱼的箱子有两个已经被搬空，如今还有四箱，不阻止的话迟早被那两人搬完。“有缘者得之，今日天意如此，我就不客气了。”辰楠手抚一个木箱，意念一动，心中默念：“收！”一箱金条瞬间消失，出现在他的空间小世界中。他如法炮制收取其他装着古董与字画的箱子，不一会儿，二十几个箱子全都消失在密室里。辰楠把两个空箱子也不放过，直接收进了空间里面。做完这一切，他迅速离开密室，朝着二人离开的方向赶去。大概十几分钟的时间。常伟和柳如意去而复返。“明天得多搬点，这样太慢了。”常伟说着，率先走下阶梯。紧接着，底下传来一声惊呼：“这……这是不是走错地方了？！”柳如意闻声赶下，随即发出一声尖叫：“箱子呢？我们的箱子呢？”他们实在是想不明白，就这一会功夫，为何密室里那么多箱子不翼而飞。如此短时间内，很多人都办不成这事。难道大半夜的活见鬼了不成？辰楠悄悄靠近入口，只见底下二人面如土色，常伟疯狂地挥舞煤油灯，仿佛要多照出几个箱子来。柳如意瘫坐在地，手指颤抖地抚摸地面，似乎不相信眼前的一切。“见、见鬼了！”柳如意声音发颤，“是不是辰楠...他的魂回来了？”常伟强作镇定：“胡说什么！世上哪有鬼！一定是有人发现了这里。”“可谁能一下子搬走这么多箱子？连点声响都没有！”柳如意几乎哭出来，“整整二十多箱啊！就这么没了！”常伟突然想起什么，猛地抬头：“槐树下的那些...不会也...”二人脸色顿时惨白如纸，争先恐后冲出密室，朝庙外狂奔而去。辰楠从阴影中走出，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。好戏才刚刚开始呢。刚才他跟随二人走了一路，在他们返回城隍庙的时候，他就把槐树下藏着的东西全部收了。他望向夜空，繁星点点，恍若原主未瞑目的眼睛。“安心吧，你的冤屈，我会替你讨回来。”他轻声道，夜风拂过，似是回应。辰楠不急着离开，他重返密室，煤油灯仍在地上放着，晕出一圈昏黄的光。他俯身拾起灯，光线扫过墙角时，忽然瞥见一抹异样——那里似乎有一块砖石微微凸起，与周围不甚协调。心中一动，辰楠上前仔细查看。果然，砖石边缘有明显撬动过的痕迹。他用力一扳，砖石应声而落，露出一个小小暗格。暗格中放着一个油布包裹，打开来看，是一本泛黄的笔记和几封信件。辰楠打开翻阅，这笔记记录着大黄鱼和古董字画的来源。
content_en: In Beijing in the 1960s, the City God's Temple was no longer as popular as it once was.The vermilion paint peeled off, the beams and pillars collapsed, but the pair of stone lions were still stubbornly guarding the door. One had lost half of its ears, and the other had a cracked corner of its mouth, as if smiling bitterly at the changes in the world.As night fell, Chen Nan quietly stepped into the temple.The moonlight poured down the ground like mercury, dyeing the grass into silvery white.He took a deep breath. The air smelled of soot and dust.Before Chen Nan arrived, he heard voices coming from inside. The owners of the voices were none other than Liu Ruyi and Chang Wei."You are indeed here." Chen Nan murmured to himself, thinking of the situation when he fell into the water during the day.If he hadn't happened to travel through time, there would have been a corpse waiting to float.The temple is covered with cobwebs and the statues are covered in dust.Chen Nan bypassed the main hall and went straight to the back room.There is a hidden underground secret room entrance there, which the three of them accidentally discovered a few days ago.At that time, they had vowed to protect this secret together, but now that I think about it, it was just a trick by the two of them to stabilize the original owner.Chen Nan hid behind a broken screen and held his breath.Not long after, the sound of footsteps came closer and closer."Viagra, hurry up, I'm afraid someone will see it." Liu Ruyi's voice was delicate and urgent.Chang Wei walked in front holding a kerosene lamp, "Don't worry, ghosts don't come here at night in this poor place. Besides, that boy Chen Nan has already fed the fish, and no one knows our secret." Chen Nan sneered in the dark, what a couple, the original owner is dead, but he is also alive.Liu Ruyi was wearing a floral gown, with two braids hanging on her shoulders, looking particularly pure in the moonlight.Chang Wei is not as tall and handsome as Chen Nan, but his father is a leader. Although he looks ordinary, he comes from a good family, so he is the dream lover of many girls."Just move two more boxes tonight. I'm worried about attracting more attention." Chang Wei said, moving a living brick in the corner to reveal the stairs extending downward.Liu Ruyi nodded, "I listen to you, but... I always feel uneasy. As soon as Chen Nan died, we..." "Don't mention that unlucky guy!" Chang Wei interrupted her, "He accidentally fell into the water, what does it have to do with us? Besides, it's one less person to share, isn't it?" Chang Wei felt guilty when he said this. Chen Nan fell into the river because he pushed her, and he refused to save her, otherwise Chen Nan would not have died.Now he doesn't even know that Chen Nan is not only not dead, but is also secretly watching his every move.The two of them walked down the secret room one after another, their voices fading away.Chen Nan walked out from behind the screen. He walked quietly to the entrance and listened.There was the sound of heavy objects being moved from below, and Liu Ruyi gasped: "This big yellow croaker is so heavy..." They couldn't move even one box, so they had to pack the big yellow croaker in batches and take them out."Hey Shen, this one big yellow croaker used to be enough for an ordinary family to eat for half a year." "Unfortunately, now that food is in short supply, one big yellow croaker can't be exchanged for much food." Chang Wei picked up a big yellow croaker with a look of regret on his face, "We can wait until everything here is moved away.So I can rest assured." "There is no market price for this large yellow croaker, but it is definitely worth a lot of money.We can exchange it for food on the black market." Liu Ruyi's eyes lit up as she looked at the large yellow croaker. Nowadays, gold control is extremely strict. Even if you have gold, you must hide it from others.Once someone discovers it, it is very likely that they will be labeled randomly.Will be regarded as "the tail of capitalism" or "the cancer of the old society".Going to the black market to exchange for food is also very risky. If you are caught, you will be speculating, which will not only harm yourself but also your family.Chen Nan narrowed his eyes. No wonder the original owner was always ordered to watch the wind in the last few days in his memory.What a trick to lure the tiger away from the mountain. It can only be said that the original owner is a licking dog and a love brain.When the footsteps of the two people faded away, Chen Nan quickly got into the secret room.The kerosene lamp was still there, and under the dim light, more than twenty wooden boxes were neatly arranged.Chen Nan opened the nearest one, and the golden yellow croakers were neatly stacked, dazzling.In another box are scrolls of calligraphy and painting. Looking at the exquisite mounting, it is definitely an unusual thing."Tsk, tsk, tsk, they are all good things!" "Liu Ruyi, you have successfully brainwashed the original owner." Chen Nan couldn't understand why the original owner would let Liu Ruyi control such a huge amount of wealth without hesitation.It can only be said that this is because the dog-licking attribute was defeated by the daughter of destiny.This wealth was enough to drive countless people crazy in the 1960s.Chen Nan walked around the secret room and checked all the boxes.I found that most of the items in the secret room were antique calligraphy and paintings. There were three boxes of large yellow croakers and three boxes of small yellow croakers.A box of large yellow croakers weighs an estimated sixty kilograms, and a box of small yellow croakers weighs about thirty kilograms. Six boxes of gold is definitely a huge fortune no matter where it is.But what is more valuable are the antique calligraphy and paintings, which are like national treasures.In a special period like the 1960s, holding gold would cause huge trouble once it was discovered, and people kept it secret.Although Chen Nan is also short of money now, he doesn't dare to take the big yellow croaker to the bank to exchange for money, as he will be strictly questioned by the staff.Inquiries about sources, need for certificates, registration records, and political risks all exist.If you can't explain the origin of the gold, you will get into huge trouble.Explaining the origin of the gold will also lead to a dilemma, where the gain outweighs the loss.It is considered the tail end of capitalism, and those who have gold are either landlords or capitalists.It is very possible that the whole family will be sent to the farm for renovation.Moreover, gold at this time had no market price because gold in the 1960s was rarely in circulation.If I have to say a price, it is the official price given by the bank, which is more than three yuan per gram. When you are in urgent need of money, you can go to the black market to exchange it.(Twelve taels of large yellow croaker, one tael of small yellow croaker) However, nowadays, food is in short supply, and one large yellow croaker cannot be exchanged for much food, which shows the importance of food.Two of the boxes containing large yellow croakers have been emptied, and now there are four boxes left. If they don't stop them, they will finish them sooner or later."Those who are destined can get it. God's will is like this today, so I won't be polite." Chen Nan touched a wooden box with his hand, and thought silently in his heart: "Take it!" A box of gold bars disappeared instantly and appeared in his small world of space.He followed the same pattern and collected other boxes containing antiques, calligraphy and paintings. After a while, all twenty boxes disappeared into the secret room.Chen Nan didn't let go of the two empty boxes and put them directly into the space.After doing all this, he quickly left the secret room and rushed in the direction the two of them left.It takes about ten minutes.Chang Wei and Liu Ruyi left and came back."Move more tomorrow, it's too slow." Chang Wei said, taking the lead to walk down the stairs.Immediately afterwards, an exclamation came from below: "This...is this the wrong place?!" Liu Ruyi heard the sound and rushed down, and then screamed: "Where are the boxes? Where are our boxes?" They really couldn't figure out why so many boxes in the secret room were missing in just a moment.Many people cannot do this in such a short period of time.Could it be that there was a ghost in the middle of the night?Chen Nan quietly approached the entrance and saw the two people below with earthy faces. Chang Wei was waving the kerosene lamp crazily, as if to illuminate a few more boxes.Liu Ruyi slumped on the ground, stroking the ground with trembling fingers, as if she didn't believe what she was seeing."What a ghost!" Liu Ruyi's voice trembled, "Is Chen Nan...his soul back?" Chang Wei forced himself to calm down: "What nonsense! There is no ghost in the world! Someone must have discovered this place." "But who can move so many boxes at once? There is not even a sound.!" Liu Ruyi almost cried, "More than twenty boxes are just gone!" Chang Wei suddenly thought of something and suddenly raised his head: "Those under the locust tree..." The two people's faces suddenly turned pale as paper, and they rushed out of the secret room and ran towards the outside of the temple.Chen Nan walked out of the shadows with a sneer on his lips.The fun has just begun.He had just followed the two of them all the way, and when they returned to the City God's Temple, he collected all the things hidden under the locust tree.He looked at the night sky, where the stars were dotted, as if the original owner's eyes were still open."Don't worry, I will take back your grievances for you." He said softly, and the night breeze seemed to be a response.Chen Nan was not in a hurry to leave. He returned to the secret room. The kerosene lamp was still on the ground, casting a dim yellow light.He leaned over and picked up the lamp. When the light swept across the corner of the wall, he suddenly caught a glimpse of something strange - there seemed to be a piece of brick that was slightly raised, which was not in harmony with the surroundings.With a thought in his heart, Chen Nan stepped forward to take a closer look.Sure enough, there were obvious signs of prying on the edges of the masonry.He pulled hard, and the bricks fell down, revealing a small hidden grid.There was an oilcloth package placed in the secret compartment. When you opened it, you found a yellowed notebook and several letters.Chen Nan opened it and flipped through it. The note recorded the origin of the large yellow croaker and antique calligraphy and painting.
